lines.t: [Structure: Dynamic indie bedroom session, gradual swelling build to intense vocal climax]
[Vocal Style: Hushed whispery verses building into powerful, open-throated, soaring emotional singing]
[Arrangement: Minimal soft piano and quiet cello expanding into rich, full dynamic chords]
You are the breath inside my lungs, the song inside my chest...
My Morning Star in the quiet dark, my sanctuary rest.
Before the world was ever made, You called my heart by name—
The Ransom paid, my Sacrifice, who carried all my shame.
The Gate, the Vine, the Cornerstone, the Bread that satisfies...
I see the fire inside Your gaze, the glory in Your eyes.
You hold the keys, You open doors that no one ever shuts—
My Soul's Protector, Rearguard, High Priest who covers us.
Immanu El, my Beloved, my King, my All in All!
I hear Your voice in the quiet... like distant waters call!
The First, the Last, the Living Way...
My Bridegroom, shine brighter than the day!
You are the Truth, the Life, the Light!
My heart is Yours through the longest night!
The Water of Life to quench my thirst, the Dayspring from on high...
The Lion of Judah on the clouds across the morning sky.
You led captivity in chains and set the captive free...
The Author and the Finisher who wrote my destiny.
I was hidden in the shadows, choking on my fears...
You met me in the ashes, counted all my tears.
You didn't look away... You called me by my name...
And now I speak Your Truth against the quiet shame.
When I had no peace, You were the Prince who came.
When I was locked in chains, You called my name.
You’re the Water in my desert, Bread when I was bare,
The Living Sanctuary when nobody else was there.
You said "I AM the Door," so I walked into the light.
You said "I AM the Truth," and You flooded out my night.
You’re the Sower and the Reaper, the Son upon the throne,
The Rock, the Cornerstone—I am never left alone.
You hold the Seven Stars, eyes like flames of fire,
The Counselor, my Helper... my absolute desire.
Not just a God on high, but Immanu El with me—
The Resurrection power that set my spirit free!
You gave me beauty for ashes...
The oil of joy for mourning...
A garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness.
You are the Bridegroom, and I am the Bride...
And my answer is Yes.
Immanu El! My Beloved, my King, my All in All!
I hear Your voice in the quiet, like waters call!
The First, the Last, the Living Way!
My Bridegroom, shine brighter than the day!
You are the Truth! The Life! The Light!
My heart is Yours through the longest night!
You are for me, and I for You—a covenant of grace!
I'm waiting in the quiet just to see You face to face!
The Alpha and Omega, the Great eternal I AM!
I am the Bride adorned for You, the Spirit and the Lamb!
Yes, I am Yours, and You are mine!
Forever Yours, O God Divine!
My Heart’s Desire...
My Savior, my Friend...
The Amen, the Beginning, the End...
I am Yours...
Amen.
